reviews.review_msg: Dr. Bird is awesome. He really cares about how you do in his class, he gives good feedback on the assignments. Overall really chill guy would def recommend taking a course with him.
Flexible with assignment topics and methods. Be prepared for short in-class reflections about readings but don't stress out about them too much. Very kind and approachable if you need help.

Super nice professor. Gave great feedback and had interesting course content/readings. Just make sure you do the readings since there's lots of discussion/sharing thoughts (participation is recorded, but you won't be cold called) and also for the weekly in class reflections. Would definitely recommend!

Easy-going, super kind prof. You do need to speak in class/tutorial as he keeps note of this for participation grades. You also need to do the readings so that you have something to write about for the weekly in-class writing assignments, but it's not too difficult.
John is a chill guy who teaches interesting material and is easy to approach about feedback! Would recommend taking a course with him
SFU is lucky to have Dr. Bird. Genuinely my favorite prof so far– hilarious man, what a gem.

Dr. John Bird is a wonderful professor! He genuinely cares about the subject and the success of his students. He's also very understanding of how busy life gets and will let you write any missing in class assignments during his office hours. I would definitely recommended him if you're taking courses in history or Indigenous studies!
Approachable, lots of readings and class discussion, cares about students, highly recommend.
